text: Frequency separation: the natural frequencies of the coupled foundation - soil system in the vertical, horizontal and rocking modes and of the table-top structure shall differ by at least 20 % from the operating frequency (50 Hz, 3000 rpm), from twice the operating frequency where the OEM gives excitation at that frequency, and from every other excitation frequency of the OEM; the resonance zone shall not be crossed at a speed where sustained vibration is possible (transient crossing during run-up and coast-down shall be checked for amplitude).
